verdict.rationale: The IPO's own published pages state that trade mark applications can be sent online [uk-ipo-docs-5] and that patents can be filed online through a One Login account [uk-ipo-docs-8, uk-ipo-supp-2]. They also describe digital services to apply for, manage and renew patents [uk-ipo-docs-22], and the fee is stated exactly on the page [uk-ipo-supp-1], so the core filing transaction is clearly completable online. Missing for 10: no explicit first-party statement that payment is taken within the online flow, and no independent or hands-on corroboration of completing a filing end to end.
